title: Hip Pain Guide
meta_description: A practical hip pain guide for powerlifters.
strapline: A step-by-step framework to move better and get back to training.
subtitle: This page will walk lifters through the same process you use to identify what is going wrong, improve movement and build strength back up.
highlights: Work out what is actually aggravating the hip
Use the right mobility drill for the problem
Build strength back into the positions that matter
video_heading: Start here: what is driving your hip pain?
video_copy: Use this video to explain the common reasons powerlifters develop hip pain and how to decide which route to take.
framework_heading: Work out the problem. Fix it. Get back to lifting.
framework_intro: The copy is temporary. Replace it with your own coaching process once the videos are ready.

steps.title: Identify
steps.copy: Assess the movements, positions and training stress that reproduce the issue.

steps.title: Improve
steps.copy: Use targeted movement work to improve the range or control that is missing.

steps.title: Strengthen
steps.copy: Load the improved position so the change carries over into training.

steps.title: Apply
steps.copy: Adjust squat and deadlift training so progress continues without constantly flaring it up.
